# `openpyxl.styles.proxy`

## `StyleProxy`

```python
StyleProxy(target)
```

Proxy formatting objects so that they cannot be altered

### `copy`

```python
copy(**kw)
```

Return a copy of the proxied object. Keyword args will be passed through
